claims.claim: The roadmap records TASK-415 r1 as the sole prospective NEXT, retains the CAA-04 publication identity and historical planning records, and leaves CAA-05 conditional and unselected.

Brain Sync projects a preapproved successor only after checking the exact task revision, Runtime result lineage, matching independent REVIEW PASS, reviewed SHA and current main inclusion. Missing, conflicting or stale authority yields HUMAN_BRAIN_NEXT_REQUIRED, and a completed selected task is not left actionable.

The existing publication attention path can attach a bounded read-only effective-NEXT observation after eligible publication. It checks current main, leaves wake identity unchanged, excludes unrelated publication, and ordinary Brain Sync can reconstruct the state independently of a wake.
The CAA-03 regression checks its six-file change and selected planning state against the exact historical source 7995c3048e2ca2c4606bf7bd352b03a0f8b5ffc9.

The focused failed node, tests/test_brain_attention.py::test_shared_projector_has_no_generic_semantic_router_or_downstream_activation, raised AssertionError at line 1197 because its module-wide brain_sync ban caught the authorized publication observer. The committed correction permits that reference only inside the bounded observer and retains the bans on generic routing and downstream activation. It adds no roadmap mutation or Executor action.
